mismatch.message: unsupported hero command: an unported branch of this command: wield.c reached a two-handed weapon under a shield

summary: A shielded hero selects a two-handed sword through wield.c:ready_weapon. JavaScript reaches the correct branch but throws instead of printing the C refusal and returning ECMD_FAIL. The branch must classify swords, battle axes, and other two-handed weapons by source predicates without changing equipment or consuming a turn.

source.branch: When ready_weapon receives non-null wep, does not take the corpse arm, and uarms is set while bimanual(wep) is true, C prints the type-specific two-handed refusal, sets res=ECMD_FAIL, skips retouch and setuwep, then reaches the common status condition and returns res. The selected C case is a shielded hero selecting a two-handed sword.
callers: wield.c:dowield calls ready_weapon(wep) and returns its consumed ECMD result; js/wield.js:dowield calls ready_weapon with the chosen inventory object.
wield.c:doswapweapon also calls ready_weapon(oldswap), so the same source branch must behave correctly for a two-handed swap target under a shield.
dependencies: bimanual(wep) and is_sword(wep) are source predicates with existing JavaScript implementations; BATTLE_AXE selects the alternate noun, and all other bimanual weapons use the generic noun.
Do not mutate uwep, uarms, or the selected object in the refusal arm. Preserve the common post-branch status update condition and ECMD_FAIL return, with no RNG draw.

evidence: The saved v13 evaluation at 35deeae3b45298577e919836bfad5c2da681ab6b reports 49/50 screens and cursors, 2793/2793 RNG calls, and first stop at zero-based segment 0 step 49: “wield.c reached a two-handed weapon under a shield.” The immutable recording is challenges/cases/v13/shield-refuses-two-handed-wield.session.json, SHA256 c9b77f8370672a55badb62b32c5c696642973b577df8607868edaa07fb8e1fc6.

The C recording step 49 follows the wield selection key p and displays “You cannot wield a two-handed sword while wearing a shield.” It records no RNG for that step. The prior step is the wield inventory prompt; the shield and sword were established by the independent recipe.

Upstream nethack-c/upstream/src/wield.c:169-273 defines ready_weapon. Lines 186-190 test uarms && bimanual(wep), select sword/axe/weapon wording using is_sword and BATTLE_AXE, set ECMD_FAIL, and bypass retouch/setuwep. Lines 268-273 retain the common status condition and return. Lines 451 and 483 are the dowield and doswapweapon callers.

JavaScript js/wield.js:ready_weapon around lines 548-568 reaches the same uarms/bimanual branch but throws UnsupportedWieldError. js/obj.js exports is_sword, js/objects.js exports BATTLE_AXE, and js/wield.js already uses ECMD_FAIL in adjacent wield command branches. Replace the refusal with the full source branch rather than a sword-only literal.
